page.overview:
Who is Bolo?

was the plus-one of Loquatius Seelie at the pre-Replenishment party hosted by Patia Por'co. As an NPC was played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Loquatius Seelie initially described her as gorgeous, but later told Laerryn Coramar-Seelie Bolo was "just some arm candy". Loquatius was a friend of a friend, and they were "sort of set up" -- Patia's party was the second time they'd met.

Bolo was born in Aeor as one of the three daughters of Gorus and Vitalio Maximus, an illustrious couple of the floating city.

She presumably met Loquatius Seelie during a meeting between Avalir and Aeor, and since she wanted to be a reporter like him, he took her under his wing and was helping her in this goal, bringing her to a party in Patia Por'co's home, where Bolo explained that in Aeor it was sometimes illegal to ask probing reporter-like questions.
